title: कक्षा ४ को मेरो नेपाली पाठयपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कविताहरूको विश्लेषणात्मक अध्ययन {Kakshya Char ko Mero Nepali Pathyapustakma Prayukta Kabitaharuko Bishleshanatmak  Adhyayan}
nepali: शोधशीर्षक ः कक्षा ४ को मेरो नेपाली पाठयपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कविताहरुकाविश्लेष्णात्मक अध्ययन ।शोधार्थी ः गोमा नेपालशोध निर्देशक ः सह.प्रा.डा. माधवप्रसाद आचायविभाग क्याम्पस ः नेपाली भाषा शिक्षा विभाग, विश्वविद्यलय, कीर्तिपुरशैक्षिक सत्र ः २०५९÷०६१, पृष्ठ संख्या ५९, जम्मा अध्याय ६ छन।शोधप्रक्रिया ः प्रस्तुत शोधपत्र त्रिभुवन विश्वविद्यालय शिक्षाशास्त्र सङकाय नेपालीभाषा, शिक्षा विभाग अन्तर्गत एम.एड. दोस्रो वर्ष नेपा. ५९८ पाठयांशकाआवश्यकता पूर्तिका लागि तयार पारिएको हो । यस अध्ययन कक्षा ४ को मेरानेपाली पाठयपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्त कविताहरुको विश्लेषणात्मक अध्ययनमा केन्द्रितरहेको छ । कविताहरुको सैद्धान्तिक चर्चा, पाठयक्रम अनुरुपताका दृष्टिलविश्लेषण, कविताको विभिन्न पक्षको अध्ययन र नमुना अभ्यासको अध्ययनगरिएको छ । यस अध्ययनको सिलसिलामा विश्लेषणात्मक र वर्णनात्मक विधिको प्रयोगगरेको छ । कक्षा ४ को मेरो नेपाली पाठयपुस्तकमा जम्मा ६ वटा कविताहरु रहेकाछन । पाठयपुस्तकमा समाविष्ट कविताविधा प्राथमिक शिक्षा पाठयक्रम अन्तगतरहेको विषयविस्तृतीकरणको विधा विस्तृतीकरणमा उल्लेख गरिए बमोजिमसामाजिक, नैतिक र प्राकृतिक गरी दुई–दुई वटा उल्लेख गरिएको छ ।पाठयपुस्तकमा सोही अनुसार पालना भएको देखिन्छ । केही कविता विद्यार्थीकास्तर अनुसारका भए पनि पाप लाग्छ, लक्ष्य, गाउँछ गीत नेपाली विद्यार्थी स्तरभन्दा लामा कविता राखिएको छ किनकि यस्ता लामा कविताहरु कलिलो दिमागभएका विद्यार्थीहरुलाई बुझ्न सम्झिरहन कठिन देखिन्छ । शब्दभण्डारको क्षेत्रमातत्सम शब्दहरुको प्रयाग बढी मात्रामा पाइन्छ । त्यस्त नमुना अभ्यासलाई हेदानमुना अभ्यासमा गति, यति र लय मिलाई वाचन गर्न सक्ने अभ्यासहरु राखिएका देखिदैन । अन्त्यमा प्रस्तुत शोधले कक्षा ४ को मेरो नेपाली पाठयपुस्तकमा प्रयुक्तकविता विधाका पाठहरुको पाठयक्रम अनरुपताको सरसर्ती अध्ययन गर्ने कामयसमा भएको छ । यसले शैक्षणिक तथा अध्ययन अध्यापन कार्यमा लाग्ने सबैकालागि थोरै भए पनि सहयोग पु¥याउने आशा राखेको छ ।
american_english:
Research title: An Analytical Study of the Poems Used in Class 4's Mero Nepali Textbook
Researcher: Goma Nepal
Research adviser: Assistant Prof. Dr. Madhav Prasad Acharya
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University, Kirtipur
Academic session: 2059/61; number of pages: 59; total chapters: 6
Research procedure: The present research paper has been prepared to fulfill the requirement of the Nepa. 598 course of the second year of M.Ed. under the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.
This study is focused on the analytical study of the poems used in the Class 4 Mero Nepali textbook.
A theoretical discussion of the poems, an analysis from the point of view of curricular appropriateness, a study of various aspects of the poems and a study of the sample exercises have been carried out.
In the course of this study, analytical and descriptive methods have been used.
There are a total of 6 poems in the Class 4 Mero Nepali textbook.
The poetry genre included in the textbook has been mentioned, as set out in the genre elaboration of the subject detail under the primary education curriculum, as two each of social, moral and natural.
It is seen that this has been followed accordingly in the textbook.
Although some poems are suited to the students' level, poems longer than the students' level, such as "Pap Lagchha", "Lakshya" and "Gaunchha Geet Nepali", have been included, because such long poems are seen to be difficult for students with tender minds to understand and remember.
In the area of vocabulary, the use of tatsam words is found in greater quantity.
Looking at such sample exercises, exercises enabling recitation with speed, measure and rhythm are not seen to have been included in the sample exercises.
In the end, the present research has succeeded in the task of making a cursory study of the curricular appropriateness of the poetry-genre lessons used in the Class 4 Mero Nepali textbook.
It is hoped that this will be of some help, even if small, to all those engaged in academic and teaching-learning work.

Research title: A Close Look at the Poems in the Class 4 Mero Nepali Textbook
Researcher: Goma Nepal
Research supervisor: Asst. Prof. Dr Madhav Prasad Acharya
Department/campus: Department of Nepali Language Education, University, Kirtipur
Academic session: 2059/61; number of pages: 59; chapters in all: 6
Research procedure: This research paper was put together to meet the requirement of the Nepa. 598 course in the second year of the M.Ed. under the Department of Nepali Language Education, Faculty of Education, Tribhuvan University.
This study zeroes in on the analytical study of the poems used in the Class 4 Mero Nepali textbook.
It takes in a theoretical discussion of the poems, an analysis from the angle of how well they fit the curriculum, a study of the different aspects of the poems and a study of the sample exercises.
Along the way, this study has used analytical and descriptive methods.
There are 6 poems all up in the Class 4 Mero Nepali textbook.
The poetry genre included in the textbook, as set out in the genre elaboration of the subject detail under the primary education curriculum, is listed as two each of social, moral and natural.
It comes across that this has been followed accordingly in the textbook.
Some poems suit the students' level, but poems longer than the students' level, such as "Pap Lagchha", "Lakshya" and "Gaunchha Geet Nepali", have been included, because long poems like these come across as hard for students with tender minds to take in and hold on to.
In the vocabulary area, tatsam words turn up in bigger numbers.
Looking at the sample exercises, exercises that let students recite with pace, measure and rhythm don't appear to have been included among the sample exercises.
In the end, this research has got through the job of taking a quick look at how well the poetry-genre lessons used in the Class 4 Mero Nepali textbook fit the curriculum.
It is hoped this will lend a bit of a hand, even a small one, to everyone involved in academic and teaching-learning work.
